They've gone up the ventilation shaft!|Tey How|audio=How-Ventilation.flac|}} '''Tey How''' was a [[Neimoidian]] who served as a [[battleship]] [[pilot]] for the [[Trade Federation]] during its [[blockade]] and subsequent [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. During the initial blockade, How piloted the Federation [[flagship]], the ''[[Saak'ak]]'', and gave their superiors, [[Daultay Dofine]] and [[Nute Gunray]], various reports and warnings concerning a pair of [[Jedi]] [[ambassador]]s from the [[Galactic Republic]] whom the Federation tried to [[Death|kill]] aboard the [[Starship|vessel]]. After the Jedi escaped and the full invasion of Naboo began, How transferred to piloting the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ship]] ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]''. They activated the [[battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army|army]] deployed to fight the [[Gungan Grand Army]] during the [[Battle of Naboo]] but was killed when the [[Youngling|child]] pilot [[Anakin Skywalker]] managed to fly an [[N-1 starfighter]] into the interior of the ''Vuutun Palaa'' and destroy its main [[reactor]]. ==Biography== ===Jedi escape=== {{Quote|What is going on down there?''"
"''We lost the transmission, sir!|Nute Gunray learns from Tey How that the Jedi have destroyed their battle droids|audio=GunrayAndHow.flac|}} [[File:Tey_How_Gunray_Haako_and_Sidious.png|thumb|left|250px|Tey How served under Viceroy Nute Gunray during the Invasion of Naboo.]] The [[Neimoidian]] Tey How was a member of the [[Trade Federation]] during its [[Invasion of Naboo|blockade]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] over a [[Merchant|trade]] dispute in [[32 BBY]]. They were stationed as the [[pilot]][[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] of the [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] ''[[Saak'ak]]'', which served as the [[flagship]] of the [[Trade Federation fleet]] under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Captain]] [[Daultay Dofine]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' How was seated in the [[Astrogation|navigation]] station on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] when the [[Jedi]] [[ambassador]]s [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived aboard the ''Saak'ak'' to negotiate the end of the [[blockade]] on the behalf of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. After Trade Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] tried to [[Death|kill]] the Jedi using [[poison]]ous [[dioxis]] [[gas]], a [[squad]] of [[OOM-series battle droid]]s was sent to make sure they were dead. How reported to their superiors that contact had been lost with the squad after the [[battle droid]]s were quickly destroyed by the Jedi. Panicked by the loss of the [[droid]]s, Gunray ordered How to seal off the bridge and then to close the [[blast door]]s once Jinn started to cut through the bridge doors with his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. The Jedi were forced to cease their attempt to reach the bridge once a pair of [[droideka]]s attacked them, and How reported that they had moved into the [[Starship|ship's]] vents. ===A deadly transfer=== {{Quote|We're losing power. There seems to be a problem with the main reactor.''"
"''Impossible! Nothing can get through our shields.|Tey How and Daultay Dofine discover that the Droid Control Ship is about to explode|audio=HowAndDofine.flac|}} [[File:Tey_How_death.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The destruction of the ''Vuutun Palaa'' killed Tey How.]] As the Jedi slipped aboard one of the Federation's [[C-9979 landing craft|landing craft]] and escaped the ''Saak'ak'', How informed Gunray that they were receiving a transmission from [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo on the surface below. After Amidala refused to give into the Federation's demands to surrender, [[Trade Federation Droid Army|droid forces]] were deployed to invade the surface of Naboo. How was then still present on the bridge when Gunray's master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], contacted him via [[hologram]] for an update on the invasion's progress, in which Gunray chose to avoid mentioning the escape of the two Jedi. As the takeover of Naboo proceeded, How and Dofine transferred from the ''Saak'ak'' to the bridge of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]''. When the [[Gungan Grand Army]] gathered to oppose the Trade Federation's invasion in [[Battle of Naboo|battle]], Dofine ordered How to activate their [[B1-series battle droid|droid]] [[army]] on the surface below. During the ensuing battle, the [[Youngling|child]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] piloted an [[N-1 starfighter]] into the interior of the ''Vuutun Palaa'' and fired [[missile]]s into the vessel's main [[reactor]]. How reported that the ship was losing power due to the apparent damage, but Dofine refused to believe anything had made it through the [[battleship]]'s [[Deflector shield|shields]]. However, the captain's confidence was misplaced, and the bridge erupted around them along with the rest of the ship, killing How and other members of the crew. ==Personality and traits== Tey How had mottled [[Color|green]] skin. ==Equipment== During the Invasion and Battle of Naboo, How wore a black-and-gray [[robe]] with a black [[Hat|mitre]]. They used a pair of [[data goggles]] and [[Limb|hand]]-operated data panels in the navigation station to control and pilot both the ''Saak'ak'' and the ''Vuutun Palaa''. ==Behind the scenes== Tey How was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' Their name is not spoken during the film but is listed in the credits. The character's voice was provided by two different actors, director [[George Lucas]]'s daughter [[Amanda Lucas]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sphere-of-influence-episode-guide|text="Sphere of Influence" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} under the pseudonym "Tyger" and an uncredited [[Marc Silk]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.marcsilk.com/biography|text=Marc Silk: Voice Actor - The Voice Of Your Imagination - biography|author=Marc Silk|work=[http://www.marcsilk.com marksilk.com]|archivedate=20180626111123}} In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Tey How appeared prior to the
